test_HWCToCHW: test the HWCToCHW transform converts HWC tensor to CHW format for single and batch images
test_CHWToHWC: test the CHWToHWC transform converts CHW tensor back to HWC format for single and batch images
test_HWCToCHW_roundtrip: test HWCToCHW and CHWToHWC transforms are reversible and produce identical tensors
test_HWCToCHW_invalid_shape: test HWCToCHW raises RuntimeError on tensors with invalid 2D or 5D shapes
test_HWCToCHW_batch: test HWCToCHW transform handles 4D batched tensors preserving batch dimension
